name: Metric Translation
description: Turns a request into a metric with a target value or an improvement, adjustable in real time, and applies the same step recursively to each sub-goal, rolling each up to its parent objective.
purpose: Make what success means for a request explicit and measurable as a goal record: the metric, its target, the done-standard and the budget (attempts, pieces and model calls) that Delegation and Model Plumbing enforce.
approach: Turn a request into a metric with a target value or improvement and a budget on the goal record, and roll the target of a sub-goal up to its parent objective, adjustable while the work runs.
out_of_scope: Creating the specs (ESOI Application does that), keeping the objectives (Objectives does that) and checking the result (Goal Completion does that).
milestones: 1. A request is turned into a metric with a target value or improvement that a reviewer accepts (authoritative metric metric-metric-translation).
measures_of_success: A request is turned into a metric with a target value or improvement that a reviewer accepts.
inputs: A request, and the parent target when there is one.
outputs: A metric with a target value or improvement for a request or a sub-goal.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: `hubofhubs.run("metric-translation", {"request": ...})` returns the target, its done-standard and its budget.
